definition: per SNP across any phenotype: the SNP counts as significant in an ancestry if any row for it passes the threshold in that ancestry; duplicates kept
note: no symmetric threshold reproduces all three: all_four = 12,558 implies about 3e-4, all_but_eas = 328,152 implies about 3e-3, and eur_only = 945,657 is below the value at 0.05, so it implies something looser still. The three cannot come from one threshold on this source.
